_readme.title: NotYVOS Roadmap
_readme.howto: Synchronized from NotY215/NotYVOS/docs/roadmap.md. Update the canonical OS roadmap first, then update this web snapshot.

phases.name: Kernel Foundation
phases.description: Native x86-64 kernel foundation, boot path, interrupts, CPU/SMP and core kernel services.

phases.name: Memory Management
phases.description: PMM, VMM, four-level paging, higher-half mappings and kernel heap foundation.

phases.name: Scheduler
phases.description: Task scheduling, execution infrastructure and user-fault isolation foundation.

phases.name: Storage Foundation
phases.description: VFS, initramfs and the initial NYFS storage path.

phases.name: Graphics Foundation
phases.description: Graphics API/HAL, framebuffer rendering and compositor foundation.

phases.name: Desktop Foundation
phases.description: Desktop shell, windows, Explorer, Settings, dialogs and core interaction.

phases.name: PS3 Runtime Foundation
phases.description: PS3 ABI, PPU/SPU execution, DMA, JIT and RSX runtime foundations.

phases.name: GameRunner Foundation
phases.description: GameRunner integration with the PS3 runtime and native graphics services.

phases.name: Image Decoders
phases.description: BMP, PNG, GIF, ICO and JPEG decoding integrated into the native image pipeline.

phases.name: SVG + Icons
phases.description: SVG rendering and desktop icon infrastructure integrated into the graphics stack.

phases.name: TrueType
phases.description: Inter-Regular and the native TrueType renderer integrated into the desktop text path.

phases.name: Explorer 10G
phases.description: Grid/details view, breadcrumb navigation and real file operations through VFS/NYFS.

phases.name: Clipboard
phases.description: Global clipboard, text/file lists, Ctrl+C/X/V routing and desktop clipboard integration.

phases.name: Clipboard + Dialogs
phases.description: Desktop dialogs, confirmation flows and read-only Properties integration.

phases.name: GameRunner Integration
phases.description: Session lifecycle, persistent per-game configuration and cellSaveData bridge to NYFS.

phases.name: USB + Unified Input
phases.description: xHCI, USB enumeration, HID keyboard/mouse, mass storage and unified input facade.

phases.name: Production Networking
phases.description: Ethernet, ARP, IPv4, ICMP, UDP, TCP, DHCP, DNS and user-space sockets.

phases.name: Wi-Fi Driver + Management UI
phases.description: RTL8188EU firmware integration, Wi-Fi scan/connect flow and management UI delivered; device-specific compatibility continues to evolve.

phases.name: Bluetooth Framework
phases.description: Bluetooth subsystem foundation, HCI transport, device bookkeeping, Settings UI and taskbar status integration delivered.

phases.name: NYFS Maturity
phases.description: NYFS journaling, fsck integrity checking and repair, truncation and permission-change plumbing; recovery and stress validation continue.

phases.name: Firewall + Network Security
phases.description: Firewall and network security, including stateful filtering and per-application rules.

phases.name: NotYVFirm
phases.description: Native firmware architecture, UEFI path, optional legacy path, configuration and updates.
